wing.definition:
n. a movable organ for flying (one of a pair)
n. one of the horizontal airfoils on either side of the fuselage of an airplane
n. a stage area out of sight of the audience
n. a unit of military aircraft
wing.translation:
n. 翅膀, 翼, 机翼, 派别
vt. 给...装上翼, 飞过, 使飞, 空运, 增加...速度
vi. 飞行

wing collar.translation: 硬翻领, 上浆翻领; 翼领

wing shooting.translation: 飞鸟射击; 飞靶射击

wing-beat.translation: n. （鸟翼在飞行中的）一扑棱；（鸟翼似的）一扑闪

wing-beats.translation: (wing-beat 的复数) n. （鸟翼在飞行中的）一扑棱；（鸟翼似的）一扑闪

wing-collar.translation: n. （衬衫的）翼领, 燕子领

wing-collars.translation: (wing-collar 的复数) n. （衬衫的）翼领, 燕子领

wing-commanders.translation: (wing-commander 的复数) n. （英）皇家空军中校

wing-footed.definition:
a. Having wings attached to the feet; as, wing-footed
   Mercury; hence, swift; moving with rapidity; fleet.
a. Having part or all of the feet adapted for flying.
a. Having the anterior lobes of the foot so modified as
   to form a pair of winglike swimming organs; -- said of the pteropod
   mollusks.
wing-footed.translation: a. 快步如飞的, 飞快的, 迅速的

wing-nut.translation:
na. 【机】蝶形螺母
[网络] 螺纹旋紧型导线连接器

wing-shaped.translation:
adj. 翼形的
[网络] 翼型法；飞翼型

wing-spans.translation: (wing-span 的复数) [航] 翼展；翼层

wing-tip.translation: （飞机的）翼尖；翼波状盖饰男皮鞋

wing-tips.translation: (wing-tip 的复数) （飞机的）翼尖；翼波状盖饰男皮鞋

wingback.definition:
n. (football) the person who plays wingback
n. (American football) the position of the offensive back who lines up behind or outside the end

wingbeat.translation: n. 飞行时翅膀的拍击

wingbeats.translation: (wingbeat 的复数) n. 飞行时翅膀的拍击

wingding.translation: n. 狂欢会, 喧闹的聚会, 一阵发作

winged.definition:
a. having wings or as if having wings of a specified kind; 
s. very fast; as if with wings
winged.translation: a. 有翼的, 高速的, 迅速的, 飞行的, 翼受伤的

winged bean.translation: 有四个翼瓣豆荚的豆; 翼豆

winged everlasting.translation: [网络] 麦秆菊；永恒之翼；铁菊

winged words.translation: 高扬的言词, 堂皇的话

wingeing.translation: (winge 的现在分词) n. (Winge)人名；(丹、瑞典)温厄

wingel.translation: 氢氧化铝、氢氧化镁混合物

wingers.translation: n. （足球）侧翼运动员( winger的复数形式 )

winging.definition: v travel through the air; be airborne
winging.translation: n. 向边装货；沿舷布置重量

wingless.translation: a. 没有翼的, 没有翅的

winglet.definition:
n. A little wing; a very small wing.
n. A bastard wing, or alula.

winglets.definition:
plural of winglet
n. A little wing; a very small wing.
n. A bastard wing, or alula.
winglets.translation: (winglet 的复数) n. 小翼, 小翅

wingletted.definition:
past participle of winglet
n. A little wing; a very small wing.
n. A bastard wing, or alula.
wingletted.translation: (winglet 的过去分词) n. 小翼, 小翅

winglike.definition: s resembling a wing in shape or position

wingman.definition: n. the pilot who positions his aircraft outside and behind (on the wing of) the leader of a flying formation
wingman.translation: n. 僚机驾驶员, 僚机

wingmanship.definition: n. Power or skill in flying.

wingmen.definition:
plural of wingman
n. the pilot who positions his aircraft outside and behind (on the wing of) the leader of a flying formation
wingmen.translation: (wingman 的复数) n. 僚机驾驶员, 僚机

wingo.translation: [人名] 温戈; [地名] [美国] 温戈

wingover.translation: n. 跃升转弯半滚倒转飞行

wingrove.translation: [人名] [英格兰人姓氏] 温格罗夫住所名称，来源于村庄名Wing+古英语，含义是“树丛”(grove)

wings.definition:
n. a means of flight or ascent
n. stylized bird wings worn as an insignia by qualified pilots or air crew members
wings.translation: n. 舞台两侧, 侧景

wings of sphenoid bone.translation: [医] 蝶骨翼(包括大翼及小翼)

wingspan.definition: n. linear distance between the extremities of an airfoil

wingspans.definition: n. linear distance between the extremities of an airfoil
wingspans.translation: n. 翼展, 翼幅( wingspan的复数形式 )

wingspread.definition: n. distance between the tips of the wings (as of a bird or insect) when fully extended

wingy.definition:
a. Having wings; rapid.
a. Soaring with wings, or as if with wings; volatile airy.
